name: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Complete Edition
storyline: After enduring more than thirty years of drought, famine, and relentless war with the invading Kushan Empire, the Persian Empire stands on the brink of collapse. When the latest Kushan incursion pushes deep into Persian territory, it is turned back by the legendary warrior clan known as the Immortals. Their youngest member, the gifted young fighter Sargon, personally slays the enemy general and is hailed a hero. But the celebration is shattered when Sargon's own mentor, the revered General Anahita, abducts Prince Ghassan and flees to the sacred Mount Qaf, a mountain crowned by a once-great citadel long ago ruined by a mysterious curse. Determined to rescue the prince and uncover the truth behind this shocking betrayal, Sargon and the Immortals set out in pursuit, unaware of the strange and dangerous forces awaiting them.
summary:
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown is a 2.5D action-adventure platformer. It follows Sargon, a warrior searching for a kidnapped prince in the cursed city of Mount Qaf. The game features acrobatic platforming, time-based powers, and a Metroidvania-style world.

The Complete Edition features the base game, the Mask of Darkness story DLC, 3 outfits for Sargon, the Prosperity Bird Amulet, and a digital adventure guide.
